mission.title: Witness Rescue
mission.description: Rescue two kidnapped witnesses to the hardline sabotage.

npc.say: First the man at the phone booth, and now these thugs! Well, at least they're nicely dressed, for criminals.
It's weird how a guy looking just like these kidnappers here was also snooping around the sabotaged phone booth.

phase.briefing: The hardline saboteurs are fighting back! Since you interviewed a bluepill hardline witness, other witnesses have been abducted by unknown assailants. Warrior, Zion's scanners have traced two of these kidnapped witnesses to a building in your area. It will be your task to liberate the captive bluepills and get whatever information you can about the saboteurs and kidnappers. Are you prepared for this hazardous mission?

enter.say: I'm detecting activity in two separate areas in that building, operative. The kidnappers may have split their hostages up. Don't forget, we need these bluepills alive!

objective.text: Kill the program guarding Deja Willows

done.say: Congratulations, Warrior--that was a powerful program that you just defeated. Now, see if the witness Deja Willows has any useful information.

talk.say: Hey, you're really great! How can I --oh, the phone booth? Well, I was using the phone, when this man came along and just hung up the receiver! Then he pulled me out of the booth and shut himself inside. I went to find a cop, and when I got back to the booth, the man was gone. He was dressed in dark glasses and a suit, just like these men here.
Interesting. This information should be useful to Zion.

done.say: You've wiped out all of the kidnappers, Warrior. Your combat skills are improving nicely.
Nicely done, Warrior. Now let's see what Alonzo Blair can tell us about the saboteurs.

talk.say: Gosh, thanks! How can I repay you? Oh, the phone booth sabotage? Well... come to think of it, I saw a man with a blinking red device, just like these guys have, lugging a black box near the phone booth right before I got to it and found that it had been tampered with. Could that have been a coincidence?
Nice work, operative. This is useful information.

objective.text: Do not let the witnesses die

complete.say: All goals achieved! You can leave the mission area now, operative.

mission.finish: Commander Lock will be most interested to hear this information that you've gathered from those witnesses. Your services have been quite valuable, operative. Don't doubt that they will be repaid in full once Zion triumphs over the Machines.
